info.description: Standalone workspace graph. JSON byte limits are UTF-8 byte limits; schema maxLength constraints are advisory character limits.

metadata.description: Namespaced keys, e.g. aq:priority; at most 16384 UTF-8 bytes.

verification.description: New nodes of either kind start unverified; assertions are independent of task completion.

provenance.description: Unique source_id values, at most 16384 UTF-8 bytes total.

created_by.description: Immutable authenticated creator. Legacy snapshots may omit this field; legacy default is legacy:unknown.

items.description: Committed node/edge result. Old idempotency receipts preserve the original LegacyNode payload without alias rewriting.

relationships_available.description: True only when both compared revisions have exact retained link sets.

Source.description: Attributed typed source descriptor. This service does not fetch external content or prove retention/access/approval of external task, review, or artifact systems.

evidence.description: Unique source_id values, at most 16384 UTF-8 bytes total.

VerifyKnowledge.description: Legacy operation name for shared task/knowledge verification; same authority and evidence rules.

RevisionSnapshot.description: Exact node and owned link versions: all outgoing links plus incoming blocks/parent-child. Legacy missing link sets are explicitly unavailable.

ContentType.description: Shared content classification for tasks and knowledge.

VerifyNode.description: Admin-only evidence assertion on either kind; nonempty mutation reason required.

SetSummary.description: Store derived text citing the current record revision; null clears summary and citation. Other meaningful changes invalidate it.

include_disputed.description: Search only; lists include disputed records.
